item.title: How Lula beat far-right Bolsonaro in Brazil – The Latest
item.description: Brazil’s Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a historic fourth term as president, defeating the far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in a dramatic comeback. Lula is the first candidate to win a runoff election after losing in the first round, taking victory with 51.79% of the vote to his rival’s 48.21%. His win bucks a regional trend, after the son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro had spearheaded a radical populist movement. But with Flávio Bolsonaro refusing to concede defeat, what’s next for Brazil? Michael Safi speaks to Latin America correspondent Tom Phillips – watch on YouTube… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: Non-hierarchical movement is seeking to ‘rebuild society’ in Balkan country after years of authoritarian rule Serbia’s triumphant but untested Student List movement is preparing to start talks on forming a government capable of reversing 14 years of increasingly authoritarian nationalist rule, after a seismic weekend election win . item.title: Opponents accuse Netanyahu of stoking tensions with Iran before Israel's election
item.description: Israel's defence minister denied on Monday (October 26) reports of a rift between PM Netanyahu and the army over Iran, before the vote. Netanyahu has campaigned heavily on his security credentials, insisting only he can "finish the job" in the US-Israeli war on Iran. His main rival, ex-army chief Gadi Eisenkot, has accused him of playing up the Iran threat when it suits him politically, and of failing to accomplish his war goals. FRANCE 24's Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Israelis can’t vote from abroad, so tens of thousands of expats are expected to fly home for the election. item.title: Sheinbaum despide a la encargada de las elecciones en México por corrupción

La salida de su titular se produce a menos de un año de las elecciones de medio termino, cuando se renovará la Cámara de Diputados, diecisiete gubernaturas en los estados y todas las alcaldías del país.El INE es uno de los grandes triunfos de la lucha democrática… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

Gernot Döllner joined Trump on stage after the US president gave a speech criticised by the head of an elected body of employees at Audi’s parent company, Volkswagen, as being full of “racism, sexism, transphobia [and] contempt for democracy”.
